beggar.summary: An old beggar with a gray beard, a brown hat, a rope belt, a cup, and a walking stick. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hat, the coat, and the cup have clear differences.
strengths: The gray beard, the mustache, and the curly gray hair match the mockup.
The rope belt, the blue patches, and the teal sleeves match the mockup palette.
The cup and the walking stick are in the correct hands.
issues: The hat is a hard round dome with a stiff brim. It looks like a metal helmet. Make a soft, floppy hat with a dented crown and a wavy brim.
The coat is a short knit vest to the hips. Make a long, ragged brown coat to the knees with visible patches.
The cup is small, silver, and clean. It looks like a glass. Make a larger, dark, dented tin cup.
The nose is small. The mockup has a large, round pink nose that is a focal point of the face.
The mustache hides the mouth, so the gentle smile does not read. Show a small smile under the mustache.
In walk, the cup arm stays still (known base limit).
beggar.next: Replace the helmet-shaped hat with a soft, floppy, dented hat.

scribe.summary: A young scribe with brown hair, a brown jacket, a scroll board, a white quill, and an ink bottle. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The scroll board, the long white quill, the ink bottle, and the cross strap all match the mockup.
The brown jacket, the dark scarf, the green shorts, and the brown boots match the mockup palette.
The face reads as calm and focused with a small smile.
issues: The hair is a lumpy mop with a round mass at the back. Make a smooth, side-swept fringe like the mockup.
The jacket stops at the hips. The mockup coat is longer and hangs to the thighs.
The quill points forward and down. In the mockup, the quill points up.
In walk, the arms stay still (known base limit).
scribe.next: Reshape the hair into a smooth, side-swept fringe.

storyteller.summary: A cheerful old storyteller with a white bun, gold round glasses, a patchwork shawl, an open book, and a green toy dragon. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The white bun with the red wrap, the gold round glasses, and the earrings match the mockup.
The open book and the green toy dragon read clearly in the views and in the sprites.
The patchwork shawl with fringes gives a warm, cheerful color plan.
issues: The shawl is a round poncho that covers the full body. The mockup shawl drapes long at the sides and shows more of the dress.
The dress is purple. The mockup dress is a muted maroon.
The bun is lumpy and looks like a cauliflower from the back. Make a smoother, neater bun.
In walk, the arms stay still (known base limit).
storyteller.next: Make the shawl drape long at the sides and show more of a maroon dress.

student.summary: A cheerful young student with red hair, freckles, a green flat cap, a satchel, and a raised slate with a chalk star. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The green flat cap, the red hair, and the freckles match the mockup.
The raised slate with the chalk star is the focal point and reads at 128 px.
The satchel, the tie, the shorts, and the gray socks match the mockup.
issues: The shorts flare wide and show no gap between the legs. They look like a skirt. Split the shorts into two legs.
The jacket is dark navy. The mockup jacket is a lighter slate gray-blue.
The free hand is a fist at the side. The mockup hand is open and waves (known base limit).
In walk, the slate arm stays still (known base limit).
student.next: Split the shorts into two clear legs so they do not read as a skirt.

tailor.summary: A friendly young tailor with a black bob, a red bow, a yellow measuring tape, big silver scissors, and a spool of red thread. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The big silver scissors and the red spool with a loose thread read clearly in every view.
The black bob with the red bow, the teal blouse, and the yellow tape match the mockup.
The pin cushion on the wrist is a good role detail.
issues: The skirt is dark gray and stops above the knees. The mockup dress is black and longer.
The mouth is open with two small front teeth. The mockup has a softer, closed smile.
The mockup has a small dot on the forehead. The model does not show it.
In walk, the arms stay still (known base limit).
tailor.next: Make the skirt black and longer, like the mockup dress.

prospector.summary: A cheerful old prospector with a bushy gray beard, a wide brown hat, a red shirt, suspenders, and a gold pan. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The wide hat, the bushy gray beard, the red shirt, and the suspenders match the mockup.
The gold pan is held out in the correct hand.
The belt tool and the blue work pants give good role detail.
issues: The pan is light silver-gray and the nuggets are small and dull olive-yellow. Make a darker pan with larger, bright, shiny gold nuggets.
The hat is stiff and smooth. The mockup hat has a pinched crown and a soft, wavy brim.
The free hand is a fist. The mockup hand is open and waves (known base limit).
At 128 px, the hat hides the face in most directions.
prospector.next: Make the nuggets larger and bright gold so the pan reads as treasure.

riverboat-captain.summary: An old riverboat captain with a white beard, a navy cap with an anchor, a navy coat, and a brass spyglass. The outfit matches the mockup, but the face reads stern, not jolly.
strengths: The navy cap with the gold anchor and the black visor match the mockup.
The double row of gold buttons and the white belt with a gold buckle match the mockup.
The white beard and mustache frame the face well.
issues: The eyebrows slant down to the center and the mouth is a small grimace. The face reads angry. The mockup has raised brows and a wide, laughing smile. Raise the brows and open a wide smile.
The irises are pink-red. Make them a normal brown or blue.
The spyglass points down at a low angle and looks like a baton. Hold it out forward at chest height.
The body is not very round. The mockup captain has a large, round belly.
The hand on the hip does not read. Bend the elbow out and put the fist on the hip.
In walk, the arms stay still (known base limit).
riverboat-captain.next: Change the face to raised brows and a wide, laughing smile.

cartographer.summary: An old cartographer with a white beard, round glasses, a green coat, brass dividers, and rolled maps. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hair and the glasses have clear differences.
strengths: The raised brass dividers and the bundle of rolled maps read clearly.
The green coat with gold buttons and the brown vest match the mockup.
The kind face with round glasses reads at 128 px.
issues: The head is bald with a small white puff on top. The mockup has full white hair swept up into a crest. Cover the top of the head with swept-back white hair.
The glasses are gold. The mockup glasses are black.
The maps are pale cream. The mockup maps are tan parchment.
The white hair at the back is a lumpy band.
In walk, the arms stay still (known base limit).
cartographer.next: Replace the bald dome and puff with full, swept-up white hair.

dockworker.summary: A cheerful dockworker with a red knit cap, a brown beard, a striped shirt, suspenders, and a wooden crate. The front matches the mockup, but the body is not big.
strengths: The red knit cap, the brown beard, the striped shirt, and the suspenders match the mockup.
The wooden crate held in both arms is the clear focal point.
The color plan matches the mockup palette.
issues: The body is the standard size. The mockup dockworker is big, with wide shoulders and a thick torso. Make the shoulders and the torso wider.
The rope is one small yellow ring. It looks like metal. Make loose rope coils that hang from the hands.
From the side, the beard reads as a dark round patch on the cheek. Blend it into the jaw and the hair.
The fists go into the sides of the crate.
In walk, the arms stay still (known base limit).
dockworker.next: Make the shoulders and the torso wider so the dockworker reads as big.
